closed_loop_round_2026-08-06._note: First edits authored WITH the judge in the loop (museum_match --tile): diagnose from real components, edit, judge, keep the number. Two hypotheses, both tested.

castelvecchio-pinch-v2.verdict: CONFIRMED — capacity was the whole gap. A PERFECT score (every component maxed): the edited lineage beats its ancestor, beats the crowned castelvecchio 7.60, and ties the chapter leader soane 8.00.

components.promise: 0.5 -> 0.5 (unchanged despite hero on the entry centre column)

kanazawa-vista-v2.verdict: REFUTED, and instructively. Both halves of the diagnosis were wrong: eliminating overflow did NOT move tau, and putting the hero dead-ahead on the spawn column did NOT earn promise CENTER. So on a free-plan matrix the encounter order is set by the DRIFT, not by the slot inventory, and CENTER is a fact about where the gaze points at step 1, not about geometry. Kanazawa needs a directed walk, not more slots — which may be a thing its identity cannot give.

closed_loop_round_2026-08-06.method_finding: Wave 3 authored three edits blind and lost three. This round authored two against real component readings and went 1 win / 1 clean refutation — the refutation being worth as much, because it is knowledge the proxy model could never produce.
